rationale: The HUD speed readout is `heliocentricKms.toFixed(2)`, derived in the page from `flyHeliocentricSpeed` (alias for `heliocentricSpeed`). The page hardcodes the Earth–Mars Hohmann semi-major axis for all non-moon missions, so for outer planets the vis-viva radicand becomes negative and this function returns NaN. The look-alike `visViva` in `src/lib/orbital.ts` shares the same formula but is not on the runtime path, and the failed patch incorrectly targeted the page instead of the pure-function owner.
